programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Official FAQ: 'PGDM (AICTE approved) - Rs 8.95 Lakh' (same for PGDM-Business Analytics; MBA (Global) with Malaysia University of Science and Technology Rs 8.75 lakh, total fee). Batch year and breakdown not stated; hostel extra (amount not published).
programs.intakeNote: Not published on the official pages checked.
programs.placementNote: Official placement page: Placement 2025 for Batch 2023-25 - highest CTC 16.42 LPA, second 12.50 LPA, third 9.50 LPA, average CTC 6.85 LPA, 1000+ opportunities, 100+ recruiters. Covers GBS programmes collectively (PGDM / PGDM-BA / MBA Global not split). No median published.

selectionProcess.name: Application and national entrance test
selectionProcess.detail: Score in CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT or ATMA; Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate (50% in X and XII also stated on PGDM page).

selectionProcess.name: Globsyn Aptitude Test (GAT)
selectionProcess.detail: Includes an essay and a short video profile; GAT must be passed.

selectionProcess.name: Group Discussion and Personal Interview
selectionProcess.weightage: GD 20 marks, PI 25 marks; diversity/extracurriculars 10 marks
selectionProcess.detail: Selection on a 100-mark scale; minimum total of 50 marks required.

selectionWeightage.note: Out of 100 marks per official GBS FAQ; candidates must score at least 50. Batch year not stated.

keyDates.notes: No dated admission calendar published; applications via admissions.globsyn.edu.in or walk-in at the Salt Lake admission office.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
